`seek.webm` is an original four-second VP9 test pattern generated with ffmpeg:

```sh
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=160x90:rate=5 -t 4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 30k -an seek.webm
```

The packaged smoke adds a sparse EBML Void element inside its Segment to exceed
the old complete-file video limit without checking a large binary into Git.
Audio fixtures are sparse stereo 48 kHz PCM WAV files generated by the test.
